comments:
[9BEDJZXI]: 172. He was born in Zung mkhar. 
[BKUHJCNA]: 741. He followed Tsong kha pa (ID: 5636) for a long time and also heard many teachings from his two chief spiritual sons. So, due to that Lord's kindness, he obtained unobstructed knowledge of "dbu tshad dang | bde gsang."
alternative_names: lce ston kun dga' bzang po
name: sems dpa' chen po kun dga' bzang po
